name: Maisonneuve Fracture
definition: Proximal fibular fracture associated with syndesmotic disruption and medial ankle injury, representing an unstable ankle-ring injury.

typical: Ankle pain with proximal fibular tenderness

investigations.principle: Ankle and full-length tibia/fibula radiographs are required; CT may help syndesmotic assessment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Unstable syndesmotic injury usually requires fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Jangha/Gulpha bhagna-Snayu phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Proximal fibular fracture associated with syndesmotic disruption and medial ankle injury, representing an unstable ankle-ring injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
